$comment: Overhead lines NPCs say on their own in rsprox.net captures (https://rsprox.net/database), current cache ids, built 2026-11-25. `gap`: ticks between lines (between phrases, when the NPC has them) while it stayed in view, quantiles [5, 25, 50, 75, 95]; `lines[].weight`: sightings in the NPC's newest revision with 3 recordings of it (lines that revision should have shown but did not, such as past news, are dropped); `seq`/`sound`: the animation and area sound that come with most of a line's sightings, or `gestures`: the weighted alternatives when the NPC alternates them; `order`: the fixed cycle, when the NPC keeps one; `phrases`: lines the NPC always says in this order (a sermon's sentences), `phraseGap` the ticks between them; `fighting`: said while the NPC fights; `family`: taken from the NPC's family (same name but its number) when the NPC is too thinly recorded alone. Lines said while the player targeted, talked to or fought the NPC, lines that follow a player action, and lines the Wiki transcripts give only for a trigger are left out. See rsprox_npc_says.py in osrs-captures.
